TrueType glyf outline decoder.

Decodes simple glyphs (points, flags, deltas) and composite glyphs (component records with scale/2x2 transforms) into draw ops. Any inconsistency inside a glyph makes the decode fail with none / false; out-of-range table access is contained the same way rather than raising, mirroring how glyphBoundsUnscaled returns none for bad loca data.
